subject: Boardroom prep: roadmap confidence & blocker log
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Boardroom prep: roadmap confidence & blocker log

Team —

Attaching the snapshot and blocker register for tomorrow's board prep slot. Goal: come to the pre-brief with a single-slide narrative we can use in the board pack and one clear ask per owner. High-level summary below.

One-paragraph current status:
- Roadmap: Core inference runtime and Dedicated rollout are on the planned track; two non-critical feature flags (structured output parity, telemetry shaper) slipped ~2 weeks.
- Launch timelines: Public hosted GA target: 2027-08-01. Dedicated pilot cohort: staggered in July.
- Confidence: Overall execution confidence 72% (engineering) — see attached metric table in roadmap_snapshot_v3.pdf.

Top 3 delivery risks (with short impact and mitigation asks):
1) Memory regression on 70B quantized path — impact: increased latency > SLA for some customers; mitigation: prioritize kernel fix + temporary routing to 40B variant. Ask: Vivek to commit owner and ETA.
2) Autoscale race condition under flash-burst traffic — impact: request throttling / failed in-flight requests; mitigation: patch + extended load test. Ask: Lauren to confirm test window and result by EOD Monday.
3) Customer rollout readiness for Acme Platform — impact: potential delayed pilot; mitigation: preflight runbook and customer-facing rollback plan. Ask: Monica to lead customer sync and provide explicit yes/no for July cohort.

Wanted outputs for our leadership pre-brief (by EOD today):
- One-paragraph confidence statement per owner (1–2 lines).
- Updated blocker_register.xlsx with owner, ETA, and rollback option.
- Any customer escalations that would change timeline (flag as P1).

Attachments:
- roadmap_snapshot_v3.pdf (pdf, 1.9MB)
- blocker_register.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Thanks — I’ll stitch into the board deck after your updates.

Rishi
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Boardroom prep: roadmap confidence & blocker log

Rishi — thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes: 

- Memory regression (70B quantized): I have Pavan and the kernel team on triage. Preliminary root cause looks like a cache compaction bug under long sequences; estimate for a candidate patch: 48 hours. If we can't get the patch in quick, we will route high-percentile traffic to the 40B variant for affected customers. I'll add ETA and owner into blocker_register.xlsx.

- Autoscale race: Lauren and infra are the right owners; agree we need the load window. Recommend we schedule a focused 90-min run with synthetic flash-bursts (Fri, 09:00 PDT) to validate the fix.

- Confidence blurb: Engineering remains cautiously optimistic — core runtime stabilizing after last two sprints; remaining high-severity risks are owner-identified with tactical mitigations.

I also uploaded a short runbook + telemetry dashboard link to the drive folder.

Vivek
Head of Engineering
Redwood Inference

Looping Sam from Acme so they're aware of our current timeline and the mitigation approach if the 70B path has performance issues. Sam — we expect to confirm the pilot cohort by Monday; if we can't commit, we'll offer the 40B route for the July pilot and plan a follow-on migration.

Sam, quick context: we discovered a memory regression affecting long-history queries on a quantized 70B configuration. Owner + patch ETA are being worked; Rishi asked for explicit customer readiness confirmation today. Please tell us if Acme can accept the 40B fall-back for the pilot or needs the 70B baseline.

Monica
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

- Autoscale race condition: we have a repro and a patch candidate. Planning a Friday 09:00 PDT focused run to validate (90 mins). Owner: Lauren / Infra SRE team.
- Test coverage: extended soak scheduled Wed night; results posted to drive.

Thanks all — this is great and granular. Final asks before I consolidate into the board packet: 

1) Vivek: paste one-line owner + ETA for the 70B patch into blocker_register.xlsx (inline cell next to the item).
2) Lauren: confirm Fri 09:00 run and flag if we need additional infra hours to extend window.
3) Monica: confirm Acme decision (40B fallback OK?) or note blocking customer requirement.

Pre-brief: Let's meet at 14:00 PDT for a 30-min sync to finalize the single-slide narrative. Calendar invite going now.

I'll take the slide assembly once you drop the updates. If anything pops as P0, ping me directly.

Rishi
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
